result.analyst_notes: Factual, business-led framing with aspirational superlatives ('unmatched', 'uniquely position us'). Commitments are often hedged ('focused on', 'committed to'). Voice mixes first-person plural with third-person description. Shareholders, employees and communities are grouped in one sentence. Safety and environment appear briefly. No customer, DEI or integrity language.
